n_dba0f008601c4a26.name: Read the last run time
n_dba0f008601c4a26.source: export default async function window(_input,context){const until=Date.now(),saved=await context.state.get('last-company-run');let since=saved;if(since==null){since=until;await context.state.set('last-company-run',since)}if(!Number.isSafeInteger(since)||since<0||since>until)throw Error('Invalid company watermark');return {since,until}}

n_b720064ebcf76cc4.name: Collect HubSpot companies
n_b720064ebcf76cc4.source: export default function pages({since,until,previousState,response,statusCode}){let state=previousState??{companies:[],seen:[],cursor:null};if(!Array.isArray(state.companies)||!Array.isArray(state.seen))throw Error('Invalid company progress');if(response!=null){if(statusCode<200||statusCode>=300||!response||!Array.isArray(response.results))throw Error('Invalid HubSpot list');let companies=state.companies;for(const c of response.results){if(!c||typeof c.id!=='string'||!c.properties||typeof c.updatedAt!=='string')throw Error('Invalid HubSpot company');const t=Date.parse(c.updatedAt);if(!Number.isFinite(t))throw Error('Invalid company timestamp');if(t>=since&&t<until)companies=companies.concat([c])}const paging=response.paging;if(paging!=null&&(typeof paging!=='object'||Array.isArray(paging)))throw Error('Invalid HubSpot paging');const next=paging?.next;if(next!=null&&(typeof next!=='object'||Array.isArray(next)||typeof next.after!=='string'||!next.after))throw Error('Invalid HubSpot cursor');const cursor=next?.after??null;if(cursor!=null&&(typeof cursor!=='string'||!cursor||state.seen.includes(cursor)))throw Error('Invalid HubSpot cursor');state={companies,seen:cursor?state.seen.concat(cursor):state.seen,cursor}}return {state,more:response==null||state.cursor!=null,params:{limit:100,properties:'name,domain',...(state.cursor?{after:state.cursor}:{})},companies:state.companies,hasCompanies:state.companies.length>0,count:0}}

n_f19c9518993d0c1c.name: Collect Zendesk organizations
n_f19c9518993d0c1c.source: export default function pages({previousState,organizations,pagination}){let s=previousState??{items:[],page:1};if(!Array.isArray(s.items)||!Number.isInteger(s.page)||s.page<1)throw Error('Invalid organization progress');if(organizations!=null){if(!Array.isArray(organizations)||!pagination||typeof pagination.hasMore!=='boolean')throw Error('Invalid Zendesk page');if(pagination.hasMore&&s.page>=100)throw Error('Zendesk offset pagination exceeds 100 pages');s={items:s.items.concat(organizations),page:pagination.hasMore?s.page+1:0}}return {state:s,more:organizations==null||s.page>0,page:s.page||1,items:s.items}}

n_0accd36a95dbf13e.name: Match organizations by name
n_0accd36a95dbf13e.source: export default function plan({companies,organizations}){if(!Array.isArray(companies)||!Array.isArray(organizations))throw Error('Invalid records');const names=new Map();for(const o of organizations){if(!o||!Number.isSafeInteger(o.id)||typeof o.name!=='string')throw Error('Invalid Zendesk organization');let k=o.name.toLowerCase();names.set(k,[...(names.get(k)||[]),o])}const seen=new Set(),plans=[];for(const c of companies){const name=c.properties?.name,domain=c.properties?.domain;if(typeof name!=='string'||!name.trim()||typeof domain!=='string'||!domain.trim())throw Error('Company name or domain missing');let k=name.toLowerCase();if(seen.has(k))throw Error('Duplicate HubSpot company names');seen.add(k);const matches=names.get(k)||[];if(matches.length>1)throw Error('Duplicate Zendesk organization names');plans.push({id:matches[0]?.id??null,name,domain})}return {plans}}

n_d2e7a2c838497e70.name: Prepare the next organization
n_d2e7a2c838497e70.source: export default function next({plans,previousState,confirmed}){if(!Array.isArray(plans))throw Error('Invalid company plans');let index=0;if(previousState!=null){if(!Number.isInteger(previousState.index)||!confirmed||confirmed.ok!==true)throw Error('Organization write not confirmed');index=previousState.index}if(index>=plans.length)return {state:{index},more:false,isCreate:true,endpoint:'/api/v2/organizations.json',body:{},expectedId:null,count:index};const p=plans[index];return {state:{index:index+1},more:true,isCreate:p.id===null,endpoint:p.id===null?'/api/v2/organizations.json':'/api/v2/organizations/'+p.id+'.json',body:{organization:{name:p.name,domain_names:[p.domain]}},expectedId:p.id,count:index}}

n_ff53d7d1e0f84015.name: Confirm the organization
n_ff53d7d1e0f84015.source: export default function confirm({statusCode,body,expectedId}){if(statusCode<200||statusCode>=300||!body||!body.organization||!Number.isSafeInteger(body.organization.id))throw Error('Zendesk did not confirm organization');if(expectedId!==null&&body.organization.id!==expectedId)throw Error('Zendesk confirmed a different organization');return {confirmed:{ok:true}}}

n_b65c79158693fb7f.name: Save the completed run
n_b65c79158693fb7f.source: export default async function finish({count,until},context){if(!Number.isSafeInteger(count)||!Number.isSafeInteger(until))throw Error('Invalid run completion');if(count>0)await context.state.set('last-company-run',until);return {count}}
